findings.title: AI & automation is the #1 digital CX priority for 2026
findings.insight: 40.6 % of global digital leaders rank AI and automation as their top focus for 2026—nearly three times higher than any other trend.

evidence.snippet: AI and automation dominate the 2026 CX agenda, with 40.6% of global leaders ranking it as their top priority—nearly 3x higher than any other trend.
evidence.source_file: CONTENT SQUARE – What’s Next in CX: 2026 Digital Customer Experience Trends_ACIG.pdf

findings.title: Omnichannel experience rises to #2
findings.insight: Omnichannel experience climbs to second place, with 13.8 % of leaders naming it their main focus for 2026.

evidence.snippet: Omnichannel experience climbs to second place for 2026, with 13.8% of leaders naming it their top focus.
evidence.source_file: CONTENT SQUARE – What’s Next in CX: 2026 Digital Customer Experience Trends_ACIG.pdf

findings.title: Digital innovation enters the top-three priorities
findings.insight: Digital innovation breaks into the top five and takes the #3 spot for 2026, reflecting demand for AI-driven differentiation and faster productization.

evidence.snippet: Digital innovation enters the top 5 as a new trend, reflecting demand for AI-driven competitive differentiation.
evidence.source_file: CONTENT SQUARE – What’s Next in CX: 2026 Digital Customer Experience Trends_ACIG.pdf

findings.title: Personalization drops to #4 but remains essential
findings.insight: Only 10.8 % of digital leaders now cite personalization as their foremost priority, signaling that it has become a baseline capability rather than a stand-alone strategy.

evidence.snippet: Personalization slipped from second to fourth place in 2026, with 10.8% of digital leaders ranking it as their top priority.
evidence.source_file: CONTENT SQUARE – What’s Next in CX: 2026 Digital Customer Experience Trends_ACIG.pdf

findings.title: Data-driven insights round out the top five
findings.insight: Data-driven insights rank fifth for 2026; 8.8 % of leaders select it as their primary CX focus, emphasizing the need for actionable analytics and real-time data.

evidence.snippet: Data-driven insights rank as the fifth trend of 2026, with 8.8% of leaders naming it their top CX priority.
evidence.source_file: CONTENT SQUARE – What’s Next in CX: 2026 Digital Customer Experience Trends_ACIG.pdf
